constraints.offlineMode: All core setup, catalog, planning, batch, history, photo, export, and restore workflows use local data. Network failure may disable ads and crash upload but never the product core.
performance: Local reads and writes must not visibly block interaction; Today and batch detail open from local state without waiting for network; image work is bounded and off the main thread.
privacy: No account, product analytics, attribution, location, advertising identifier, user identifier, or user-authored grow content is sent by product code.
Yandex Ads is the only provider and remains off until the canonical region/consent gate permits initialization.
Crashlytics is release-default-on with a Settings opt-out and contains only minimized technical diagnostics.

action-targeting-integration.nextAction: Add explicit typed command targeting through model, Store, UI router and production data tests.

approved-inline-ad-placement.integrationGoal: Trace and verify the already implemented single inline native ad at the exact approved Catalog and explicit History positions, with zero UI or requests on prohibited, unavailable, short, offline, unresolved, failed, preview and iOS states.
approved-inline-ad-placement.nextAction: Bind ad lifecycle and component evidence now; defer only the required final ui-golden record/verify surface.

assets.integrationGoal: Every approved ASSET ID has a production Compose resource, provenance, manifest evidence, and later reachable typed use reviewed in screen goldens.
assets.nextAction: Create and validate the approved reusable icons, original vectors, and catalog illustrations.

canonical-advertising-privacy-runtime.integrationGoal: Use one ProductSettings-backed privacy payload for strict endpoint freshness, policy-bound consent, backup/restore/erase, production Android runtime gating, and unconditional iOS no-ID disablement.
canonical-advertising-privacy-runtime.nextAction: Replace the duplicate Android privacy store with the canonical adapter and verify AC-102 through AC-107 before product UI/native banner integration.

core-domain.integrationGoal: The production root can create a feasible plan, advance a persisted batch through its lifecycle, recover after restart, and preserve catalog and history invariants.
core-domain.nextAction: Publish and verify the pure domain vocabulary, invariants, algorithms, manager contracts, and catalog identity contract.

crash-reporting-runtime.integrationGoal: Android and iOS production startup restore the persisted privacy-minimal crash preference, apply it before routine reporting, react immediately to Settings changes, remain disabled in non-release hosts, and expose the effective or unavailable state without requiring external Firebase configuration.
crash-reporting-runtime.nextAction: After reminder delivery returns shared host ownership, wire the crash coordinator and native drivers into the retained production graph, surface effective state in Settings, and add platform/component/settings integration tests.

foundation.integrationGoal: Android and iOS production entry points construct and render the shared production root; strict quality, preview/screenshot smoke, and CI tasks are wired.
foundation.nextAction: Create the verified KMP delivery foundation without changing feature product behavior.

foundation-correction.integrationGoal: The foundation sources pass strict Detekt while preserving the Android/iOS production root and preview behavior.
foundation-correction.nextAction: Apply the evidence-backed Detekt correction and issue a superseding handoff.

local-data.integrationGoal: A real KMP data graph persists complete local state, survives restart, atomically restores a full archive with photos, exports CSV, and erases all local product state.
local-data.nextAction: Implement SQLDelight, Settings, private file storage, manager adapters, backup/restore, CSV, migrations, and deterministic tests.

managed-observation-photo-lifecycle.integrationGoal: Import a system-picked observation photo into canonical app-private storage, persist only stable managed identity, restore and render it after process restart, support explicit Keep/Replace/Remove with atomic compensation and orphan cleanup, and preserve Android/iOS no-broad-permission parity.
managed-observation-photo-lifecycle.nextAction: Implement and verify AC-074 on platform-test, file-integration-test and component-test, then refresh the final UI goldens.

monetization-privacy.integrationGoal: Establish strict privacy-region and consent gating plus Android inline Yandex ad lifecycle and an unconditional iOS no-ID safe-disabled adapter; downstream packages register AC evidence after prerequisites close.
monetization-privacy.nextAction: Implement fail-closed privacy and ad contracts without live identifiers, project creation or external publication.

platform-services.integrationGoal: Establish the cross-platform service implementation and conditional Firebase configuration contract. Acceptance evidence is registered later by downstream integration packages after prerequisite AC packages close.
platform-services.nextAction: Implement platform services and safe external Firebase configuration contracts without creating projects or embedding identifiers.

product-ui.integrationGoal: The shared Android/iOS Compose entry surface renders all sixteen AppSpec screens through production EN/RU resources with compact and adaptive navigation, accessible interactions, deterministic preview states, and reachability from the production root; domain-dependent end-to-end evidence is registered only after prerequisite packages close.
product-ui.nextAction: Implement the complete stateless product UI, production resource catalog and primary preview matrix using approved assets and the completed Lazyweb evidence.

production-integration.integrationGoal: Connect the verified data, root and platform contracts in the retained Android/iOS production graph so document/photo flows, future reminder reconciliation, erase-to-first-run navigation, lifecycle, localization and safe external configuration work end to end.
production-integration.nextAction: Add the root reset seam, platform adapters and production graph wiring, then verify Android/iOS compilation and integration tests without creating external projects.

reminder-delivery-integration.integrationGoal: Notification settings persist independent daily-summary and soak choices plus local summary time, screen state reflects real permission, and Android/iOS production lifecycles idempotently reconcile one useful daily summary and future soak reminders after changes, restart, restore and time-zone signals without weakening Today.
reminder-delivery-integration.nextAction: Implement settings migration/backup, complete ReminderPlan derivation, host permission/lifecycle bridges and exact platform/component/integration tests.

trays-history-category-correction.integrationGoal: Trays exposes explicit Planned, Active, and History peer categories, filters persisted batches deterministically, retains selection within the active category, and gives downstream advertising an unambiguous History-only eligibility contract.
trays-history-category-correction.nextAction: Add the minimal typed tray-category state across snapshot, component/UI adapter, production rendering, and deterministic tests without changing batch persistence semantics.
